main.description: A user's testimony on a bill, stored in the user's own repo. Record key convention: '{court}-{billId}' — at most one testimony per bill per user; putRecord with the same key is an edit. Author identity comes from the repo DID; display names, roles, and legislator routing are resolved by an AppView. No version history: the PDS keeps only the latest record.

bill.description: Strong reference to the org.mapletestimony.bill record this testimony addresses.

court.description: Denormalized general court number, for filtering without resolving the bill ref.

position.description: The author's stance on the bill.

content.description: Testimony text. Limit matches MAPLE's maxTestimonyLength.
